title: The waiting-page skill merges a second account's page copy into a live page
why: Owner note on item 398, 12:00 CST Nov 8: two Claude accounts on his Mac both worked degen, banchi and other repos, and each wrote its own waiting page; he asks how to aggregate them so each page is full. The skill has "Before you switch Claude accounts" (export into git) and "Rebuild a page from the repo" (into an EMPTY page only); it has no step that adds a git copy's missing items to a LIVE page. Fix: a written step plus an export_page.py mode that emits set writes only for ids the live page lacks, renumbering an n that is taken. Triage gave the owner two interim prompts in item 398's reply (12:02 CST).
